description: Enterprise metadata search synonym dictionary. Each group is a list of equivalent terms — searching any one term will match all others in the group. Multi-word entries (e.g. 'job order', 'bank transfer', 'case study') are matched as a whole phrase by data/vocabulary_service.py before single-token expansion runs, so they don't get decomposed into unrelated single-word groups. Extend this file to add new synonym coverage. No restart required if the service is reloaded.
